newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices slide as rains hurt output.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices slide as rains hurt output.

text.p: Indian castorseed September delivery prices on Wednesday fell to 1,129/1,130 after gains earlier in the day, dealers said.
Arrivals of castorseed remained negligible due to heavy rain in producing centres but the absence of overseas buying dragged prices lower after a firm start.
Groundnut oil slid 1/2 rupees at 355/356 rupees per 10 kg amid sluggish physical buying but inflows were low at 30/40 tonnes following heavy rain in producing centres.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil rose by five rupees at 555 rupees per 15 kg on low arrivals and shortage of ready stock.
In Bombay, imported palm oil climbed up from 267/268 rupees to 270/272 rupees per 10 kg.
"The price rise in the local market may prove shortlived as marketmen are expecting arrivals of about 4,000/5,000 tonnes of imported palm oil at the Bombay port within a day of two," one miller said.
